statement: This sketch portrays an arid, cracked landscape dominated by deep terracotta tones and sharp fissures that emphasize the dry, weathered earth. The scene features a muted beige sky that creates strong contrast with the rich, saturated ground. Small dust devils drift across the terrain, providing subtle movement and natural flow to the composition. The work uses simple geometric forms and carefully chosen color values to evoke a sense of stillness and vastness, capturing both the harshness and the quiet beauty of a desert environment.
